title: 游击
slug: 第一战场指挥官全本免费-第一战场指挥官最新章节列表
content_zh:
物资箱里的子弹四种混合, 但数量并不均分。机¨枪最多, 其次冲锋¨枪, 随后是手¨枪, 最后才是连胜的狙击¨枪。
两个物资箱加起来, 狙击¨枪的子弹才只有五发, 可以说相当匮乏。
既然已经合作，赵卓荦也不隐瞒，他把昨天找到标记牌的位置简单提了一下。只是没有地图, 他不好讲解，依靠大致描述，位置真假不做评判。
两人决定, 从最近的地方开始攻略, 以环形路线进行扫荡。
原先是埋伏等候，现在是主动出击。
连胜把狙击¨枪给赵卓荦背着, 自己改用冲锋¨枪, 顿时觉得轻松不少。
赵卓荦对这一带非常熟悉, 知道什么地方适合埋伏, 也知道什么地方会有危险。
“看看有没有新鲜的脚印。”赵卓荦, “教官放置物资, 走的时候，会把附近的脚印顺便清理掉。”
两人就根据周围的脚印，遮蔽物, 地形, 以及一些风吹草动，来判断目标的所在。事实证明，不是所有的人，都有连胜那样的毅力。一般学生在狙击的时候，保持抬头的动作过长，都会忍不住动一动。
他一动，连胜的枪就跟着动。于是击杀数一路飞飙。
付教官斜坐在椅子上，翘着腿，感慨唏嘘道：“你们不知道，她刚入队的时候，连枪支的种类都分不清楚。怎么拿枪还是我教她的。”
旁边众勤恳工作的教官们：“……”
实在是要听不下去了，这货还是赶紧滚吧。
于是付教官被众人赶了出去。
赵卓荦带着连胜，在山上飞驰拿人头。
照理来说，在人员没有轮替完之前，山上人数应该始终保持在两百名左右才对。可是他们继续走，遇到的人却越来越少。而从“尸体”上的子弹数量来看，多数也是新上山的人。
这说明某个地方，可能有大团体出现了。
与此相应的，连胜也发现，赵卓荦在有意识的带着她往复绕圈，狙击一个范围内的敌人。她保持沉默，没有提出异议。
在天色快发黑之前，赵卓荦终于走出了圈子，往另外一个方向过去。
那边有一块特别茂盛的植被，连胜还认得其中的两棵。常见的野生草药。

赵卓荦让她蹲下，以防被别人发现。
连胜说：“什么也看不见。”视线里全是绿色。
赵卓荦：“我知道。先试试。”
这边没有大型的石头，也没有繁密的树木，距离标记点不算很远，如果角度够刁钻，是可以贯穿的。
赵卓荦选了颗树，枝叶少的，不会阻挡视线，而后爬上树干。他转着方向，四面看一圈。脚下不敢踩实，大半是依靠手臂的力量，单手吊着。借着狙击¨枪上的目镜，给她通报位置。
“你现在的位置，往右大约三米处……”赵卓荦顿了顿说，“抬头看，右斜角三十度左右，有一颗四米多高的尖顶树，树底左边就是标记点。”
连胜点头。
赵卓荦继续看，发现了一个可疑的地方。
其实那人伪装的很隐蔽，基本看不出那草皮里有什么。只不过，那绿色的草皮是人形的。
赵卓荦已经没有空闲的手了，脚下也站不稳，低头向连胜汇报情况。
“你面前左三米左右，前数第三棵树，叶子长得比较细的那颗。趴在地上的高度。横躺，靠左二十公分左右的位置是他的头。”赵卓荦说，“你可以……”
他还没说完，连胜已经开枪了。
因为视线不能确保，所以她换着方向连开了两枪。
连胜打完迅速移动到另外一边，以防对方追击。抬头问了一句：“中了没？”
赵卓荦：“……不知道。”
他继续抬手查看那边的情况。
草皮人一动不动，但是另外一个男人从树后走了出来。他戒备的看了一圈，然后朝着物资点冲去。
“准备，物资点！”赵卓荦竟然也有些紧张，等着那人即将靠近的空隙，一声令下：“连射！”
连胜手上拿的是冲锋¨枪，学生选的最多的也是□□，所以弹药相对充沛。
一般男生的高度是一米八到一米九之间，弯腰捡东西的姿势，又决定了互相间高度的不同。在视线不能确定的情况下，打中一个运动中的人概率是极低的。

连胜斜刷了个十字。
赵卓荦没有说攻击范围，就是认为她打中的可能性不高。只是想让她混淆视听，阻拦一下对方的脚步。几乎在出声的同时，已经滑下树干，朝目标方向跑去。

content_en:
There are four kinds of bullets in the supply box, but the quantities are not evenly distributed. There are the most machine guns, followed by submachine guns, then pistols, and finally the sniper rifle.
Putting the two supply boxes together, the sniper rifle only has five bullets, which can be said to be quite scarce.
Now that they have cooperated, Zhao Zhuorun did not hide anything. He simply mentioned the location where he found the sign yesterday. It's just that there is no map, so it's difficult for him to explain. He relies on rough descriptions and doesn't judge whether the location is true or false.
The two decided to start their attack from the nearest place and sweep in a circular route.
Originally they were waiting in ambush, but now they are taking the initiative.
Lian Sheng gave Zhao Zhuorun the sniper rifle to carry, and switched to using the submachine gun himself. He immediately felt much more relaxed.
Zhao Zhuorun was very familiar with this area. He knew where was suitable for an ambush and where there would be danger.
"See if there are any fresh footprints." Zhao Zhuorun said, "The instructor will place the supplies and clean up the nearby footprints when he leaves."
The two of them judged the location of the target based on the surrounding footprints, shelters, terrain, and some disturbances. Facts have proved that not everyone has the perseverance to win in a row. Most students can't help but move if they keep their head up for too long when sniping.
As soon as he moved, Streak's gun followed suit. As a result, the number of kills skyrocketed.
Instructor Fu sat sideways on the chair, crossed his legs, and lamented: "You don't know, when she first joined the team, she couldn't even distinguish the types of guns. I taught her how to hold a gun."
The hard-working instructors nearby: "..."
I really can't stand listening anymore, so I better get out of here.
So instructor Fu was kicked out by everyone.
With a winning streak, Zhao Zhuorun galloped up the mountain to get heads.
Logically speaking, before the rotation of personnel is completed, the number of people on the mountain should always remain at about two hundred. But as they continued walking, they met fewer and fewer people. Judging from the number of bullets on the "bodies", most of them were newcomers to the mountain.
This indicates that a large group may have appeared somewhere.
Correspondingly, Lian Sheng also discovered that Zhao Zhuorun was consciously leading her back and forth in circles, sniping at enemies within a range. She remained silent and made no objection.
Before it got dark, Zhao Zhuorun finally walked out of the circle and headed in the other direction.
There was a particularly lush patch of vegetation there, and Lian Sheng recognized two of the trees. Common wild herbs.
Zhao Zhuorun asked her to squat down to prevent others from discovering her.
Lian Sheng said: "I can't see anything." His vision was all green.
Zhao Zhuorun: "I know. Try it first."
There are no large rocks or dense trees here. It is not very far from the marked point. If the angle is tricky enough, it can be penetrated.
Zhao Zhuorun chose a tree with few branches and leaves that would not block the view, and then climbed up the trunk. He turned around and looked around. I didn't dare to step firmly with my feet, so I mostly relied on the strength of my arms and hung with one hand. Use the eyepiece on the sniper rifle to inform her of the location.
"Your current position is about three meters to the right..." Zhao Zhuorun paused and said, "Look up and see a spire tree with a height of about 30 degrees to the right. The left side of the bottom of the tree is the marking point."
Streak nodded.
Zhao Zhuorun continued to look and found something suspicious.
In fact, the person was disguised in a very concealed manner, and it was basically impossible to see what was in the turf. However, the green turf is human-shaped.
Zhao Zhuorun no longer had free hands and could not stand firmly on his feet. He lowered his head and reported the situation to Lian Sheng.
"About three meters to the left in front of you, the third tree from the front, the one with thinner leaves. The height of lying on the ground. Lying horizontally, about 20 centimeters to the left is his head." Zhao Zhuorun said, "You can..."
Before he finished speaking, the winning streak had already begun.Shot.
Because her line of sight could not be guaranteed, she fired twice in different directions.
After the winning streak is over, quickly move to the other side to prevent the opponent from pursuing you. He raised his head and asked, "Have you been hit?"
Zhao Zhuorun: "...I don't know."
He continued to raise his hand to check the situation over there.
The Sod Man remained motionless, but another man stepped out from behind the tree. He looked around warily, then rushed towards the supply point.
"Get ready, stock up on supplies!" Zhao Zhuorun was actually a little nervous. He waited for the man to approach and gave the order: "Continuous fire!"
Lian Sheng was holding a submachine gun, and it was the one most students chose, so the ammunition was relatively abundant.
The average height of boys is between 1.8 and 1.9 meters. The posture of bending down to pick up things determines the height difference between them. When the line of sight is uncertain, the probability of hitting a moving person is extremely low.
Streak made a cross diagonally.
Zhao Zhuorun didn't say the attack range, but he just thought the probability of her hitting was low. He just wanted to confuse her and block the other party's footsteps. Almost as soon as he made the sound, he had already slid down the tree trunk and ran towards the target direction.
